definitions.explanation: Viewing or photographing distant objects using lenses or optical equipment. Composed of 望 (gaze/hope) + 遠 (distant). Most commonly used in compound words related to optics and photography.

examples.japanese: {望遠|ぼうえん}⟦レンズ→レンズ：07808_renzu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮影|さつえい}した→撮影する：21990_satsueisuru⟧。
examples.english: I photographed birds with a telephoto lens.

examples.japanese: {望遠|ぼうえん}{鏡|きょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表面|ひょうめん}→表面：03587_hyoumen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観察|かんさつ}した→観察する：21989_kansatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I observed the surface of the moon with a telescope.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{望遠|ぼうえん}⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}いている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧⟦{機種|きしゅ}→機種：13211_kishu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Some smartphone models have a telephoto camera function.

notes:
USAGE:
{望遠|ぼうえん} is most commonly encountered in compound words rather than used alone. The two most important compounds are {望遠|ぼうえん}⟦レンズ→レンズ：07808_renzu⟧ (telephoto lens) and {望遠|ぼうえん}{鏡|きょう} (telescope).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {望遠|ぼうえん}⟦レンズ→レンズ：07808_renzu⟧ (telephoto lens)
- {望遠|ぼうえん}{鏡|きょう} (telescope)
- {望遠|ぼうえん}⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧ (telephoto photography)
- {望遠|ぼうえん}⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧ (telephoto function)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{広角|こうかく}→広角：17788_koukaku⟧ (wide-angle) is the opposite concept in photography. ⟦{遠望|えんぼう}→遠望：19780_enbou⟧ means 'distant view' but refers to looking at a faraway landscape rather than using optical equipment.
